unresolved.message: Is the mozilla social text part of the illustration? It'd be helpful to have it separate so screen reader users have a heading on screen they can read to understand the context of the sign in/sign up/choose server actions that come next.
@Morgan Rae Reschenberg if we have to send users to an authentication page with their account's server, would this count as needing "haspopup" property?

@Sarah Cederberg Hi there, I'm on the a11y team, and reviewing your designs :) Can you please add annotations for screen reader users? Each element in each view should have a role, name/description, and notes about any state that needs to be communicated (ie. expanded/collapsed/checked/etc.)
You can use whatever figma library you'd like for this, though we usually recommend the plugins listed here -- https://firefox-source-docs.mozilla.org/bug-mgmt/processes/accessibility-review.html -- the focus order one has role/name/desc/state notation ability
